<Heading

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/v1/account/{account}/search"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Filter messages from a mailbox folder by search options. Search is performed against a specific folder and not for the entire account.

<Heading
  id={"request"}
  as={"h2"}
  className={"openapi-tabs__heading"}
  children={"Request"}
>
</Heading>
